description.describe_ch: 本課程分四級授課，採用不同素材，納入多元教學活動， 協助學生理解、賞析文本，建構自己的觀點，並與同儕分享、交流，以培養英語閱讀、口說、與聽力的基礎技能。
description.describe_eh: The course is divided into four levels. Different materials and diverse teaching activities were incorporated into course design to help students comprehend and appreciate texts, construct their own viewpoints, and communicate with their peers in order to develop basic skills in reading, speaking, and listening in English.

targets.describe_ch: 找到多元學習素材之主題，理解內容大意、分析重要細節及邏輯相關性。
targets.describe_en: In regard to the multiple learning materials, students can identify topics and themes, comprehend gist, and analyze important details and their logical relevance.

targets.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
targets.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.

targets.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
targets.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.

weeklyScds.tpd_learn:
• 為電腦閱卷，考試時間70分鐘，請學生攜帶2B鉛筆
  • 考試範圍為課本第一到第七課加上單字表單1-24回。
  • 試題有
    • 10題的一次次播放長篇聽力 (20%)
    • 40題單字、文法 (40%)
    • 介系詞填空 (10%)
    • 閱讀 (30%)

  1. Cheating & Plagiarism
    • For those who violate this rule, the assessment will be "no points" or the course will be "no points".
    • During the paper-and-pencil test, you are not allowed to talk, spy on other people’s test papers, or deliberately facilitate neighbors to peep, or entrainment, plagiarism, or transmission of materials, etc. If it is discovered, the test score for the offender will be counted as zero; it is a repeat offender Those who are involved will be dealt with in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Feng Chia University Student Reward and Punishment Measures.
    • If there is a test substitute, both parties involved in the fraud will be dealt with in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Feng Chia University Student Reward and Punishment Regulations.
    • Submit original works, any form of plagiarism is strictly prohibited. Those who violate this rule will be "not scored" for the assignment or "not scored" for the course, which will result in a failure in the semester grade of the course.
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol:
*學生應準時出席上課。如果您的上課時間，無法按時到課，請不要選課。 除非您生病或有緊急情況，否則應在上課前，要準時到達教室，並坐在位子上。如果您有某種原因必須提早下課，請提前告知我。
*所有學生在課堂上都應尊重每個人，並且在任何時候都應以合理、負責和禮貌的態度行事。
*上課時請勿講話、閱讀、睡覺或做其他非本課程相關作業，除分組進行討論外，否則應盡量減少邊際對話。如果您正坐在一個可能在上課時和您聊天的人旁邊，請移到另一個座位，以免您屈服於誘惑。
*當同學簡報或提問時，您應該專心地聆聽。當您簡報時，您應該面對自己的小組或全班同學大聲說話，讓同學能聽清楚。
*允許使用筆記型電腦或平板等載具，進行課堂記筆記，否則應將其收起。
*要確保在上課時，關閉手機、PDA等移動設備，並收起及保持靜音。
* 上課請帶課本，課文和習題會在課堂上做練習。
gradeRuleDescribe.course_pol_en:
Students should attend class on time. If you cannot arrive at the class on time due to your class time, please do not register for the class. Unless you are sick or there is an emergency, you should be in your classroom on time and in your seat before class starts. If you have to leave class early for any reason, please let me know in advance.
All students are expected to treat everyone with respect in the classroom and to behave reasonably, responsibly, and courteously at all times.
Do not talk, read, sleep or do other non-course-related homework during class, except for group discussions, otherwise marginal conversations should be minimized. If you are sitting next to someone who might be chatting with you during class, move to another seat so you don't give in to temptation.
You should listen attentively when classmates present or ask questions. When you present, you should speak loudly to your group or class so that they can hear you clearly.
Laptops or tablets are allowed to take notes in class, otherwise they should be put away.
Make sure that mobile devices such as mobile phones and PDAs are turned off during class, and put away and keep silent
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem:
* 缺課12節以上含12節及請假，期中考、期末考和口頭報告有缺一個以上，學期總成績一率不及格。
* 遲交作業將不予計分(Any overdue assignment will not be accepted.)
* 缺考學生需於考試當天起3天內向任課教師請假，經教師簽名同意後送外語中心始得申請補考。
* 請尊重智慧財產權，購買原文書。
* 請益時間的時段會公佈在iLearn上，請您提前預約以防止有其他學生與事務的預定。
* 如果您有任何疑問或問題，您可以運用學校Office365電子郵件或是iLearn與我聯繫。(fyliao@o365.fcu.edu.tw)
gradeRuleDescribe.course_rem_en: Learning Success Statement Please rest assured, I hope that all students can complete various learning tasks according to the teaching progress, participate in various learning activities in a regular and active manner, hand in homework on time, complete various learning tasks, and meet the learning objectives of this course. Get the grades you deserve. If you encounter learning difficulties during the school year, please make good use of my benefit time, or make another appointment with me to seek improvement solutions together. Classes invite students to form learning communities to review before exams, including tips from former students who have been successful in the course.
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno: • 考核時如果您抄襲他人的答案、或交作業時您交出全部或部分由他人撰寫的論文或作業，則被視為作弊。剽竊是對學術信任的嚴重破壞。在學習作業中，我們的言論和想法就是我們作業的價值；因此將他人的作品當作自己的作品繳交，是一種盜竊行為。當您使用別人的文字和想法時，無論是著名作家還是同學的作品，而不註明這些文章、詞語和想法的來源出處，您的行為就是在抄襲。原創性作品是我的底線，抄襲的作品將會收到“0”或“不及格”的分數。
gradeRuleDescribe.ais_meno_en:
Learning must be based on honesty. Any student who attempts to use a work that he has not produced as his own is considered dishonest. Students who cheat or plagiarize in homework, tests or exams, or assist others, will be scored as zero. If they are repeat offenders, they will be submitted in accordance with the rewards and punishments for students of Feng Chia University.
  • It is considered cheating if you copy someone else's answers during an assessment, or if you turn in a paper or assignment that was written in whole or in part by someone else when you turned in an assignment.

courseBankC.core_eng: Logical Thinking：Ability to apply clear logical reasoning to analyzing issues and developing well-structured arguments.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 針對素材所呈現之主題，有效地表達自我想法，與他人進行溝通討論。
courseBankC.describe_en: Students can effectively express their opinions on the themes of learning materials and communicate with others effectively.
courseBankC.core_item: 跨域整合的能力：能夠連結不同學科領域的知識，融會貫通，以應對社會複雜挑戰。
courseBankC.core_eng: Interdisciplinary Integration：Ability to integrate knowledge from different academic fields to address complex issues.

courseBankC.describe_ch: 藉由合作式學習，了解、尊重多元觀點的差異性，並培養團隊合作的能力。
courseBankC.describe_en: Through collaborative learning, students can understand and respect diverse perspectives and learn to cooperate with other people in teams.
courseBankC.core_item: 文化包容的能力：具備開放的態度，能同理與尊重多元文化。
courseBankC.core_eng: Cultural Awareness：Ability to understand, respect, and engage with diverse cultural perspectives.
